name: @fit-and-fed/design-system
description: Standalone, previewable design-system package for Fit & Fed (tokens, components, ComponentGallery). "main" boots the standalone Expo preview app (Metro/Expo CLI's own entry resolution only reads "main"); consumer packages importing this package BY NAME (e.g. `app/`) resolve through "exports" instead, which points at the library's real barrel file — the two are intentionally different files so the same package can be both a runnable Expo app and an importable library.
